objective: Build all twelve designs and determine which are suitable for thin-tip precision grasping with reliable contact and normal-force feedback through 20 N per finger.

rules: CAD, circuit checks, simulations and synthetic tests establish only their stated digital properties.
Do not award physical performance points for a missing experiment.
Keep raw measurements, failed builds, unavailable readings and build times.
Use independent specimens and held-out sessions; do not count adjacent frames as independent trials.
A material coupon is a development step, not completion of the installed-finger requirement.
An engineering priority is a work order, not a measured winner.

requirements.confidence_scope: one-sided, per separately declared condition; not a simultaneous family guarantee
required_tests: part identity, power, raw acquisition and fault behavior
installed fit and preservation of leading-tip access
held-out loading/unloading at different contact positions and contact areas
zero return, hysteresis, drift and long holds
no-contact jaw/motor motion and gravity poses
steel proximity, cable movement and temperature changes
repeated loading, surface wear and replacement
timed independent assembly, rework, calibration and replacement
representative precision tasks using a fixed task protocol
